race.comment: Grand pacer MINSTREL NZ (12) took advantage of a good barrier to open this campaign on a winning note last start, leading and proving much too good for his rivals by 12.5m. The second row barrier poses more of a challenge but he knows how to win from there and he has only once missed a place in 14 second-up tries, winning eight. CYCLONE JORDY NZ (2) was the eye-catcher in last week's Golden Nugget, drawing widest and getting shuffled back on the pegs before steaming home late for fourth. He could be back on track and is much better served by this draw. MIGHTY RONALDO (1) appreciated a better barrier last start but found one better, beaten by 1.7 metres at this venue. Should enjoy a lovely run and looks a player. HARRISON JOHN NZ (7) has come from similar barriers to this to win his last two outings here, the latest over MIGHTY RONALDO. Must be respected along with GOLDEN LODE NZ (3) who improved to place when second-up last start and draws much better.
